title: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants
summary: Pollination, the pollen tube, fertilisation, and how ovules and ovaries become seeds and fruits.

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT: How do Organisms Reproduce?

objectives: I can describe self- and cross-pollination.
I can explain fertilisation in flowering plants.
I can explain how seeds and fruits form.
misconceptions: Pollination and fertilisation are the same.
The seed forms from the ovary.
